title: The explicit upper-truncation counit edge
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a scheme morphism with the shared derived module categories and the normalized derived and tensor-pullback adjunctions [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image, lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction, lem-pc-pinned-derived-adjunction-shifts]. For $q\in\mathbf Z$ and $K\in D(\mathcal O_T)$ put $P=\tau_{\le q}Rg_*K$ and let $i:P\to Rg_*K$ be the truncation inclusion [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. Let $d:Lg^*P\to K$ be its derived transpose. Define the module morphism $e:H^q(Rg_*K)\to g_*H^q(K)$ to be $(H^q(i))^{-1}$ followed by the ordinary adjunct of $\kappa_{g,P}^{-1}H^q(d)$, where $\kappa$ is [lem-weil-pbc-derived-pullback-top-cohomology]. The inverse of $H^q(i)$ exists because truncation preserves cohomology in degree $q$. The canonical resolution-based local class, Leray and inverse-open class constructions used to compare this edge are retained verbatim from the parent interface [lem-trf-unbounded-direct-image-section-presheaf].
